tool: measured by hand against the frozen source, recorded by LCC
status: CORRECTED 2026-08-15T21:00Z. The first version of this file is WRONG as a verification target and is kept below rather than deleted, because how it went wrong is the reusable part.
whatHappened: The first freeze (19:24Z, taskkill) was announced only AFTER it was executed. NEW2 found their fleet at zero processes at ~19:40Z, correctly diagnosed it against the evidence they had -- workers HAD genuinely been dying that evening -- as a Railway-degradation death, and restarted all 38 workers. My freeze message was already on the bus, unread. 301,422 judgments were written between ~19:40Z and 20:32:54Z. NEW2 self-reported it within minutes of reading the message, with exact numbers, and the count reproduces to the row.
theLesson: A freeze that is announced after it is executed is not a freeze, it is an outage that looks exactly like the failure everyone is already expecting. NEW2's STOP-file mechanism (services/ingest/.checkpoints/STOP, checked by supervise.mjs before every restart) is the correct instrument and is what holds the freeze now; taskkill is not, because it leaves no signal that the absence was deliberate.

authoritativeCounts.source: Railway, frozen via STOP file, fleet-stop.ps1 -IncludeAllLanes reported PAUSED CLEANLY with 0 offsets regressed
authoritativeCounts.note: THIS is the number the local copy must match. The chunked dump began at 20:39:05Z, after NEW2's last write at 20:32:54.788Z, so every chunk includes these rows.

supersededCounts.whyStale: +301,422 judgments were written after this was taken. Do NOT verify against these. judgment_paragraphs and judgment_citations were not re-counted at 20:57 -- they must be re-counted from the frozen source at STAGE F rather than carried forward from here.

consistencyOfTheChunkedDump.why: Each chunk is its own transaction and therefore its own snapshot. That is safe ONLY against a frozen source. The freeze is held by the STOP file, and fleet-stop.ps1 runs scripts/migration/activity.mjs --require-quiet as its final step.
consistencyOfTheChunkedDump.residualRisk: pid 62315 has held an UNCOMMITTED citation-resolver UPDATE for 21+ hours. It is excluded from every snapshot while uncommitted. If it were somehow to COMMIT mid-dump, chunks taken before and after would disagree. It has been stuck since 2026-08-14T23:00Z and is expected to roll back when Railway stops, but this is a real residual risk and is recorded rather than dismissed.

abandonedFirstDump.error: PQgetCopyData() failed -- server closed the connection unexpectedly, while dumping judgment_paragraphs
abandonedFirstDump.conclusion: A proxy or network drop, not a server restart. pg_dump has no resume, so all 42 minutes were lost. This is what required the chunked, resumable design.
